title: Retain indexed exact assignment quota lookup
question: Can an in-place index improve high-fanout whole-job exact assignment while preserving every original quota and draw?
summary: Keep the Linux opt-in. Two of three paired jobs are faster, with median elapsed down 7.16%, CPU down 5.19%, exact output and equal managed temporary traffic.

workloads: 2 GiB standalone unstratified exact assignment, 1,000 equal named quotas, one worker, 128 MiB job and hard 1 GiB no-swap scope.
Complete small comparisons at eight, 1,000 and stratified 1,000 groups.

validation.summary: Three differential tests and six complete matched pairs. Independent IDs, fields, encounter order, quotas and caps, exact output bytes and recorded Analysis. All owner and temporary cleanup checks pass.

limitations: One high-fanout timed point with uncontrolled backing cache; group crossover remains uncalibrated.
Small correct-output pairs supply no speed estimate.
exclusions: Automatic selection and active Windows or WASI routes.
reopen_when: Any expansion beyond this opt-in requires a scoped benefit and active runtime validation.
